Class.name: ITFCOMMON.Utility
Class.Description:
Contains Common set of methods for Interface team.
Developed Jan 2014 by Intermountain Interface Team.

ITFCOMMON.Utility

has following methods:

  • ItfCommonLookup
  • ItfLookup
  • GetMaxError
  • SkipMsgError

Also contains following methods to call Web Service:

  1. GetHddNcidForRep
  2. GetHddRepForNcid
  3. CallMyDivideWebMethod

A utility function to save string to a file.

Syntax for calling Utility functions:
Do ##class(ITFCOMMON.Utility).METHODNAME()

Method.name: ChangeNStoCommon
Method.Implementation: set origNS = $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON" Quit origNS

Method.name: ChangeNS
Method.Implementation: set $NAMESPACE = origNS

Method.name: ItfCommonLookup
Method.Implementation: set stat = $$$OK set retVal = "" set origNS = $NAMESPACE set $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON" set retVal = ##class(Ens.Util.FunctionSet).Lookup(tableNm, key) if (retVal = "") { set retVal = defVal set stat = $$$ERROR("1000", "Value not found") } set $NAMESPACE = origNS Quit stat

Method.name: ProcessError

Method.Implementation:
Set retVal = "" Do ..ItfCommonLookup("ErrorCodes", 9301, .retVal)
Set status = $$$ERROR(9301,"ITF - Skip Msg for " _ compNm _ ": " _ retVal)
Quit status

Method.name: CheckMMI
Method.Implementation:
Set addr = "127.0.0.1" Set port = 55555 set stat = $$$OK set origNS = ..ChangeNStoCommon() try { Set gateway=..ConnectToJavaGateway(port, addr) Quit:gateway=""
set cmObj = ##class(ITF.CheckMmi).%New(gateway, "//tltst01:41210") Write !, "Created the object" set stat = cmObj.MMiexists(mmiName)
write !, "CheckMMI: " _ stat }CATCH errobj { write !, "Error in CheckMMI: " ,errobj.AsSystemError() ,", data: ", errobj.Data, "; code:" , errobj.Code set stat = 0 } // write !, "Disconnect"
Set status=gateway.%Disconnect() set $NAMESPACE = origNS Quit stat
